cases.title: Cafe menu — one image, three questions
cases.blurb: One attached image, three independent questions (two choice, one noul). Independence is structural: every question is judged in its own pass group against the same state, so adding or removing a question never changes another answer.

priciest.instructions: Which drink is the most expensive?

price_gate.instructions: Does the Macchiato cost more than $4.00?

criteria.true: the price is above the threshold
criteria.false: the price is not above it

cases.provenance: synth3 menu_board, seed 1101 — fresh render, not a dataset row

cases.title: Invoice — noul over a document
cases.blurb: A yes/no judgment over a rendered invoice. Noul is ABSOLUTE probability (not a complement-consistent pair): P(true) is what your code branches on.

criteria.false: the total is at or below it

cases.title: Seating chart — choice over positions
cases.blurb: A relative decision over a visual layout: probabilities over the seat options sum to exactly 1, with the contract's confidence derived from the distribution's shape.

seat.instructions: Which row has the most occupied desks?

cases.title: Weather forecast — scored levels
cases.blurb: A scored question: each level is judged independently (does the state match this level?), normalized at the API layer; the score is the 0-based expectation and can be fractional.

days.instructions: How many days are colder than 10 degrees?

cases.title: Chinese menu — 中文图像决策
cases.blurb: 同一张图像、中文的问题与选项 — the trained answer space stays yes/no + option names in every language; Chinese enters through the state, instructions, and criteria, never the answer tokens.

cases.title: Date arithmetic — text noul
cases.blurb: The temporal_numeric skill family: exact date arithmetic with weekday-consistent trap dates. No image — decisions over structured state alone.

state.schedule: Per the schedule, the board meeting falls 26 days after `reference_date` — no earlier and no later.

q.instructions: Is `claimed_date` a different date from the one the `schedule` describes?

criteria.true: the claimed date differs from the described date
criteria.false: the claimed date is the described date

cases.title: Eligibility chain — multi-step text choice
cases.blurb: The multi_hop family: three requirements, one question — which single requirement fails (or none)? Each option is judged against the state in its own pass; the softmax over the group is shaped in-loss during training.

requirements.case_volume_requirement: at least 3 support cases filed this quarter

q.instructions: The program grants access only if every `requirements` entry is satisfied by `application`. Which single requirement does the application fail to meet — or does it meet all of them?

cases.title: Deadline urgency — scored text
cases.blurb: A scored decision with explicitly binned levels stated in the state; gold is the bin the deadline falls into.

gold.q: low — more than 7 days remain until the deadline

state.scale: Urgency bins: critical — the deadline is today or already passed; high — 1-2 days remain; moderate — 3-7 days remain; low — more than 7 days remain.

q.instructions: How urgent is the `deadline`, per the bins in `scale`?
criteria: critical — the deadline is today or already passed
high — 1-2 days remain until the deadline
moderate — 3-7 days remain until the deadline
low — more than 7 days remain until the deadline

cases.title: 中文日期运算 — text noul
cases.blurb: 同一技能家族的中文版本：中文日期格式、中文指令与判据 — the readout heads are language-agnostic by construction.

state.schedule: 根据日程安排，产品发布恰好在 `reference_date` 之后 7 周，不早也不晚。

q.instructions: `claimed_date` 是不是 `schedule` 所描述的那一天？

criteria.true: 声称的日期就是所描述的日期
criteria.false: 声称的日期是另一个日期
